slides.text: Melanotan II: what the research and regulators actually say 👉

slides.title: A synthetic hormone analog
slides.text: Melanotan II mimics alpha-MSH and drives melanin production. Sold illegally, without a prescription, as a 'tanning injection.'
Not approved for any use. Its safety has not been established.

slides.title: Not necessarily what's on the label
slides.text: An independent analysis of products sold online found 4.3-8.8 mg of actual peptide against a stated 10 mg.
A peptide catalog, myths vs. facts, and the FDA decision timeline.
slides.foot: Educational content, not medical advice. Always show a new or changing mole to a doctor.

caption:
Melanotan II, the 'tanning injection' 🧡 Not FDA-approved, and case reports link it to new moles and melanoma. Independent tests found the content doesn't match the label.
